statement: ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, ∀ j : ℤ, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (fun k => f (k-j)) ∧ KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => f (k-j)) = KdVPlan.hn 0 f
proof:
intro f j hf
have hf' : Summable (fun k : ℤ => ‖f k‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hf
constructor
· simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight, Function.comp_def] using hf'.comp_injective (Equiv.subRight j).injective
· simp only [KdVPlan.hn, KdVPlan.weight, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
  congr 1
  exact (Equiv.subRight j).tsum_eq (fun k => ‖f k‖^2)
